get_runner_info: get the experiment runner info string from a config object using the train_runner handler
get_env_info: get the environment info string from a config object based on the env_name and train_runner
get_model_info: get the model architecture info string for a given role from a config object
get_algo_info: get the algorithm info string for a given role using the agent_rl_algo handler
get_base_role: extract the base role name by removing _tch or _st suffixes from a role string
